idle: Open a .geojson or .json file, or paste GeoJSON and validate it.
syntaxHelp: Check for missing quotes, brackets or commas.
readError: Could not read this file. Choose another file or paste its content.
type: Choose a valid GeoJSON type for this object.
properties: Feature properties must be an object or null.
id: A feature ID must be a string or a finite number.
position: A position needs at least two finite numeric coordinates.
line: A LineString needs at least two positions.
ring: A polygon ring needs at least four positions.
closedRing: The first and last positions of a polygon ring must match.
bbox: A bounding box must contain paired finite minimum and maximum coordinates.
member: This field belongs to a different GeoJSON object type.
deep: The nested structure is too deep to check in this browser.
